name: dns
description: Patchvia DNS: authoritative DNS server and web console

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix dns-server ci && npm --prefix dns-console ci && npm --prefix tools/pdns-import ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix dns-server run typecheck && npm --prefix dns-console run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix dns-server test && npm --prefix dns-console test && npm --prefix tools/pdns-import test
scripts.build: npm --prefix dns-server run build && npm --prefix dns-console run build
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t dns-server:dev dns-server && docker build -t dns-console:dev dns-console
